item.title: Long-term unemployment is becoming 'a status quo' in today's job market
item.description:
📝 8 million Americans, have been job searching for over half a year, which in most cases means they've also exhausted their unemployment insurance benefits. People who've been out of work long-term tell CNBC Make It the experience has chipped away at their confidence and made them question their career decisions. Some have taken on part-time work to pay for bills, while others have moved in with family.
🔗 Read more: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/02/16/long-term-unemployment-becoming-a-status-quo-in-todays-job-market.html
